cards.title: Structural Model Configuration Details
cards.claim: Model structure is defined by number of compartments (1-3) and absorption type (IV or Extravascular). Extravascular absorption adds Ka. Micro parameterization allows setting Ka=Ke. Clearance parameterization adds inter-compartmental clearances. An elimination compartment (urinecpt) can be added for urine data, which is ignored in steady-state dosing.
conditions: Clearance parameterization with elimination compartment removes 'Closed form?' option.
Infusions require mapping rate contexts (A1 Rate or Aa Rate).
required_inputs: Optional: Time lag (tlag), Elimination compartment flag.
limitations: Adding an elimination compartment to a Clearance model disables closed-form options.
Steady-state dosing ignores the urinecpt statement.
cards.downstream_use: Configuring the differential equations or algebraic expressions for PK simulation. Mapping data columns to model parameters.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
